summary.text: Michael Garrett is a Democratic state senator from North Carolina who represents District 27, covering Guilford County, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is the managing partner of a marketing firm and the only candidate listed for the seat on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Garrett was born in Raleigh and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Greensboro in 2007, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his profession as managing partner of a marketing firm.
Garrett has served in the Senate since January 1, 2019, succeeding Trudy Wade.

The General Assembly's website shows his committee assignments in Agriculture, Energy, and Environment; Appropriations on Department of Transportation; Commerce and Insurance; Education/Higher Education; Health Care; and Rules and Operations of the Senate.
The Democratic primary for his seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
